name: Row
description: Lays out its children left to right (drag a child to reorder).

properties.name: Spacing
properties.description: Gap between the children in dp.

properties.name: Align
properties.description: Start / Center / End / Stretch: where the children sit across the container (Stretch = full width in a Column, full height in a Row). SpaceBetween / SpaceAround: spread the children along the container.

properties.name: Padding
properties.description: Space inside the edges in dp.
